title: Legal pages and footer
summary: Legal pages such as Privacy, Cookies, Terms, Accessibility, and Hosting and security can be edited and published from Admin. The site footer groups legal and trust links, and signed-in people accept the Terms of use when they first sign in or after a material change.

added: Editable legal pages for Privacy notice, Cookies, Terms of use, Accessibility statement, and Hosting and security, with version history, compare and restore.
A Hosting and security page for signed-in people, with approved wording about London hosting and certifications.
A cookie register on the Cookies page listing the strictly necessary cookies the intranet uses.
Grouped footer links (Legal, Trust and help, About) that admins can manage; Privacy and Cookies stay visible to everyone.
Terms of use acceptance at first sign-in and after a material change, with a one-time note when Privacy or Cookies are updated.
An Acceptance report and CSV export for who has accepted the current Terms.
changed: The site footer on app, error and sign-in pages shows grouped legal links and the version pill.
accessibility: Legal pages have an on-this-page list from headings, and the footer uses group headings with keyboard-friendly links.
